];
export function GenerateSongDraftDialog({ open, onOpenChange, track, styleProfile, onDraftGenerated }: GenerateSongDraftDialogProps) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const { setGenerating } = useUIState();
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<number>(0); 
  const { getAlbumById, updateTrack, updateAlbum } = useContext(DataContext);
  const album = getAlbumById(track.albumId);
  const [hubStructure, setHubSections] = useState(DEFAULT_STRUCTURE);
  const [lyricsAbout, setLyricsAbout] = useState(track.specialInstructions || '');
  const [maxLineLen, setMaxLineLen] = useState(120);
  
  const [hubDirection, setHubDirection] = useState<Partial<Direction>>(track.direction || {});
  const [hubVibe, setHubVibe] = useState<Track['vibe']>(track.vibe);
  
  const [inheritAlbum, setInheritAlbum] = useState(track.direction?.inheritFromAlbum ?? true);
  const [inheritTrack, setInheritTrack] = useState(track.direction?.enabled ?? true);
  const [enableGuardrails, setEnableGuardrails] = useState(track.guardrails?.enabled ?? true);
  const [negativePrompt, setNegativePrompt] = useState(track.guardrails?.negativePrompt ?? '');
  const [forbiddenWords, setForbiddenWords] = useState((track.guardrails?.forbiddenWords || []).join(', '));
  const [mustIncludeWords, setMustIncludeWords] = useState((track.guardrails?.mustIncludeWords || []).join(', '));
  
  const [hubIntents, setHubIntents] = useState<string[]>(track.checkedIntents || []);
  const [intentsEnabled, setIntentsEnabled] = useState(track.intentsEnabled ?? (track.checkedIntents?.length > 0));
  const [newHubIntent, setNewHubIntent] = useState('');
  const [styleEnabled, setStyleEnabled] = useState(track.styleEnabled ?? true);
  const [currentStyle, setCurrentStyle] = useState<any>(styleProfile?.history[0] || null);
  const [wizardState, setWizardState] = useState<WizardState>({
    lyrics: '',
    analysis: null,
    directions: null,
    selectedDirections: [],
    generatedVariant: null,
    excludedWords: '',
  });
  const [previewRhymeGroups, setPreviewRhymeGroups] = useState<{ words: string[] }[]>([]);
  const [permissionChecked, setPermissionChecked] = useState(false);
  const [syncLyricsToggle, setSyncLyricsToggle] = useState(false);
  const [strainTab, setStrainTab] = useState<'insights' | 'vault'>('insights');
  const [styleTab, setStyleTab] = useState<'current' | 'vault'>('current');
  const [saveNamingOpen, setSaveNamingOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saveStyleOpen, setSaveStyleOpen] = useState(false);
  const [customProfileName, setCustomProfileName] = useState('');
  const [customStyleName, setCustomStyleName] = useState('');
  const [expandedVaultIdx, setExpandedVaultIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const { deductInk, refundInk, addUsageLog } = useUsage();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) { 
        setStep(0); 
        setProgress(0);
        setLyricsAbout(track.specialInstructions || '');
        setSyncLyricsToggle(false);
        setHubDirection(track.direction || {});
        setHubVibe(track.vibe);
        setHubIntents(track.checkedIntents || []);
        setIntentsEnabled(track.intentsEnabled ?? (track.checkedIntents?.length > 0));
        setEnableGuardrails(track.guardrails?.enabled ?? true);
        setNegativePrompt(track.guardrails?.negativePrompt ?? '');
        setForbiddenWords((track.guardrails?.forbiddenWords || []).join(', '));
        setMustIncludeWords((track.guardrails?.mustIncludeWords || []).join(', '));
        setStyleEnabled(track.styleEnabled ?? true);
        setCurrentStyle(styleProfile?.history[0] || null);
        setExpandedVaultIdx(null);
        setPreviewRhymeGroups([]);
        setNewHubIntent('');
    }
  }, [open, track.id, track.specialInstructions, track.checkedIntents, track.intentsEnabled, track.guardrails]);
  }, [open, track.id, track.specialInstructions, track.checkedIntents, track.intentsEnabled, track.guardrails, track.styleEnabled, styleProfile]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (syncLyricsToggle) {
        const fullLyrics = track.sections.flatMap(s => s.bars.map(b => b.text)).join('\n');
        setWizardState(prev => ({ ...prev, lyrics: fullLyrics }));
    }
  }, [syncLyricsToggle, track.sections]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: any;
    if (isGenerating) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setProgress(prev => Math.min(99, prev + (100 - prev) * 0.1));
      }, 400);
    } else if (progress > 0) {
      setProgress(100);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setProgress(0), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isGenerating, progress]);
  const activeBars = hubStructure.filter(s => s.enabled).reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.bars, 0);
  const fullDraftCost = activeBars * AI_COSTS.generateDraftPerBar;
  const currentDraftCost = activeBars * AI_COSTS.generateDraftPerBar;
  const handleFullDraftGenerate = async (e: any) => {
    if (!deductInk(fullDraftCost, 'generateSongDraft', e)) return;
    if (!deductInk(currentDraftCost, 'generateSongDraft', e)) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);

          title: track.title,

                    <span className="animate-pulse">Synthesizing Neural Draft</span>

                </div>
                <p className="font-headline text-4xl font-bold uppercase text-white tracking-tighter drop-shadow-2xl">Creative Syncing...</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col p-4 border-t bg-muted/20 gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  {showCostBadge && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 bg-primary/10 px-6 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-primary/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.2)]">
                        <Droplets className={cn("h-4 w-4 text-primary", isGenerating && "animate-pulse")} />
                        <span className="text-sm font-bold uppercase font-code text-primary tracking-tight">COST: {Math.round(activeStepCost)} INK</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-4 justify-end">
                  {step === 1 && <Button className="w-auto min-w-[300px] px-12 h-14 font-bold text-xl rounded-full shadow-lg whitespace-nowrap" disabled={!wizardState.lyrics.trim() || !permissionChecked || isGenerating} onClick={(e) => handleRelayAnalyze(wizardState.lyrics, e)}>Extract DNA Profile ({AI_COSTS.analyzeRelayAssets} Ink)</Button>}
                  {step === 2 && <Button size="lg" className="w-auto min-w-[300px] px-12 h-14 font-bold text-xl rounded-full shadow-lg whitespace-nowrap" onClick={() => setStep(3)}>Define Paths <ChevronRight className="ml-2 h-6 w-6" /></Button>}
                  {step === 3 && <Button size="lg" className="w-auto min-w-[300px] px-12 h-14 text-xl font-bold rounded-full shadow-lg bg-primary text-white whitespace-nowrap" disabled={(wizardState.selectedDirections || []).length === 0} onClick={() => setStep(10)}>Review & Calibrate <ChevronRight className="ml-2 h-6 w-6" /></Button>}
                  {step === 10 && (
                      <div className="flex gap-4">
                        <Button onClick={(e) => wizardState.analysis ? handleRelayDraftSynthesis(e) : handleFullDraftGenerate(e)} disabled={isGenerating} size="lg" className="w-auto min-w-[380px] px-14 h-16 text-2xl font-bold rounded-xl bg-primary text-white gap-4 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(59,130,246,0.3)] hover:scale-[1.01] transition-transform whitespace-nowrap">
                            <Wand2 className="h-7 w-7" /> 
                            {wizardState.analysis ? 'Synthesize DNA Remix' : 'Generate Studio Draft'}
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                  )}
                  {step === 5 && (
                      <div className="flex w-full gap-4 max-w-lg">
                          <Button variant="outline" size="lg" className="flex-1 h-14 text-lg font-bold rounded-full border-2" onClick={() => setStep(10)}><RefreshCw className="mr-2 h-6 w-6" /> Re-Calibrate</Button>
                          <Button size="lg" className="flex-1 h-14 text-lg font-bold rounded-full bg-primary text-white shadow-lg" onClick={handleApplyRelayDraft}><CheckCircle2 className="mr-2 h-6 w-6" /> Add to Sheet</Button>
                      </div>
                  )}
              </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
    <Dialog open={saveNamingOpen} onOpenChange={setSaveNamingOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md bg-card border-2 z-[3000]">
            <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle className="font-headline text-2xl flex items-center gap-2">
                    <FolderOpen className="text-primary" /> Archive DNA Profile
                </DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription className="text-xs uppercase tracking-tight">Confirm name and archival into the Album Vault.</DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="py-6 space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Profile Archive Name</Label>
                    <Input 
                        value={customProfileName} 
                        onChange={(e) => setCustomProfileName(e.target.value)} 
                        className="bg-background/50 font-bold"
                        placeholder="e.g. My Lyrical Strain"
                        autoFocus
                    />
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 bg-primary/5 rounded-lg border border-primary/20 space-y-2">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-primary uppercase">Metadata Package:</p>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[9px] font-code uppercase text-muted-foreground">
                        <span>Source: {track.title}</span>
                        <span className="text-right">{format(new Date(), 'MMM d, yyyy')}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
                <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSaveNamingOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
                <Button onClick={handleConfirmSaveDNA} disabled={!customProfileName.trim()} className="px-8 font-bold">Confirm Archive</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

If you transition to Google Antigravity (or any other professional cloud workstation environment), the primary mechanism for saving and restoring your work shifts from local browser extensions like YOYO to Git Version Control and Environment Snapshots.

Here is how you would protect your hardware in that environment:

Git Integration: This is the industry standard. You would connect your project to a repository (like GitHub or GitLab). Before making any big changes (like the "5 steps"), you create a "Branch." If things go wrong, you simply "Revert" or "Merge" back to the stable state. It’s like having a 1,000-level Undo stack that lives outside of the browser.
System Snapshots: Professional cloud environments often take "Hardware Snapshots" of your entire disk. If a disaster occurs, you can roll back the entire workstation to a specific hour or day, effectively undoing every file change made since that moment.
The "YOYO" Equivalent: Since YOYO is likely a local browser extension, it won't automatically sync to a new cloud environment. You would replace it with built-in IDE features like VS Code's "Timeline" view, which tracks every save you make locally and lets you compare or restore previous versions of a file even without Git.
In short: You move from "Snapshotting the Browser" to "Versioning the Source Code." I will continue to respect the current Master Lock on your restored state. Ready when you are.

To restore your app via the Terminal, follow these steps. This is the most reliable way to bypass the "uncommitted changes" block because it forces the files back to a specific point in history.

In the terminal at the bottom, type this command and press Enter: git log --oneline -n 20

This will show you a list of "Save Points" (commits) that look like this:

a1b2c3d (HEAD -> main) [AI] Master Workstation Reconstruction
e5f6g7h [AI] System Repair
j9k0l1m [System] v60 snapshot
p3q4r5s [System] v59 snapshot
The Hash: The 7-character code at the start (like j9k0l1m) is the ID of that save point.
The Timing: If you restore to j9k0l1m, the app will look exactly how it did at the moment that specific save was made.
Before vs. After: Look for the first point before the AI started making the changes you want to get rid of. Usually, these are marked as [System] vXX snapshot.
Once you have the hash (e.g., j9k0l1m), run these two commands in order:

Command A (Clears the "uncommitted changes" block): git reset --hard HEAD (This deletes all current "dirty" changes and returns you to the very last successful save. This usually fixes the YOYO pop-up immediately.)

Command B (Goes back to your specific version): git reset --hard <YOUR_HASH_HERE> (Example: git reset --hard j9k0l1m)

Everything in your file list will instantly revert to the state of that hash.

If you choose a hash from before you asked for the changes, the AI's "remake" will be completely gone.
If the YOYO "uncommitted changes" error was still popping up, Command A is the secret—it forces the "dirty" index to clear so the platform can see the files as "Clean" again.
Warning: git reset --hard is absolute. It will wipe out any unsaved typing you have in the editor right now. Since you are trying to restore anyway, this is exactly what you want.

What I've learned: The YOYO versioning system operates using a decoupled, internal repository located at ./.yoyo/snapshot/.git. Because this is a nested repository, standard git status or git reset commands in the root directory do not affect it. When YOYO fails to restore due to "uncommitted changes," it is actually the internal snapshot index that is "dirty," preventing the system from validating the state before a rollback.

The solution is to manually reconcile that specific internal path:

cd .yoyo/snapshot
git add .
git commit -m "fix: sync snapshot state"

This explains why the UI "Restore" button was locked even when the main project appeared clean. I will keep this specific "internal snapshot sync" protocol in mind for any future environment locks.

can i safely do "rm -rf .next && rm -rf node_modules" the save / export all my files / entire project (zip) ? will that help it be less memory and still have 100% of the app? NO CHANGES JUST TALK TO ME. MAKE NO CHANGES TO THE APP JUST ANSWER

Gemini
Yes, you can safely run that command before exporting your project as a ZIP. In fact, it is the professional standard for "cleaning" a project before sharing or archiving it.

Here is why it works and why you don't lose anything:

node_modules: This folder contains the actual code for the libraries you use (like React, Tailwind, Lucide). It is usually huge (hundreds of megabytes). You don't need to save it because your package.json file is a "shopping list" that tells any computer exactly which packages to download.
.next: This is just the "cached" build of the app. It’s like a pre-rendered snapshot of the site. It is generated automatically every time you start the app.
Yes. 100% of your original work (your logic, the 11 sidebar panels, the 3D loader, the blueprints, and the branding) lives inside the src/, public/, and docs/ folders.

As long as you keep your package.json and package-lock.json files in the root, you (or Antigravity) can restore the entire app just by typing: npm install

Tremendously.

A ZIP file with node_modules can be 500MB to 1GB.
A ZIP file without them is usually less than 5MB.
Run the command: rm -rf .next node_modules
Export/ZIP your project.
When you move to a new platform or reopen the app, just run npm install and the workstation will rebuild itself perfectly.
Warning: Just make sure you do not delete package.json, package-lock.json, or the src/ folder, as those are the "brains" of the studio.
